root.name: シリコン・ラボラトリーズ

rows.ja: ウェハー製造の委託先
提携・買収・資金調達

relations.text: Silicon Labsは、主にTSMCと提携する
relations.text_en: Silicon Labs partners primarily with TSMC.

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: We currently partner primarily with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.

relations.text: TSMCとSMICが半導体ウェハーの大半を製造している
relations.text_en: TSMC and SMIC manufacture the majority of Silicon Labs' semiconductor wafers

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: (“TSMC”) and Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (“SMIC”) to manufacture the majority of our semiconductor wafers.

companies.name: アロー・エレクトロニクス

relations.text: 顧客に販売する流通業者のArrow Electronicsが、2025会計年度の売上の28%を占めた
relations.text_en: Arrow Electronics, a distributor selling to Silicon Labs' customers, represented 28% of revenues in fiscal 2025

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: Two of our distributors who sell to our customers, Arrow Electronics and Edom Technology, represented 28% and 21% of our revenues during fiscal 2025, respectively.

relations.text: Arrowの売上比率は2024会計年度が27%、2023会計年度が34%だった
relations.text_en: Arrow represented 27% of revenues in fiscal 2024 and 34% in fiscal 2023

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: Two of our distributors who sell to our customers, Arrow Electronics and Edom Technology, represented 28% and 21% of our revenues during fiscal 2025, 27% and 16% during fiscal 2024, and 34% and 15% during fiscal 2023, respectively.

companies.name: テキサス・インスツルメンツ

relations.text: Texas Instrumentsは2026年2月4日、Silicon Labsを1株231.00ドルの全額現金で買収する最終契約を発表し、企業価値は約75億ドルとなる
relations.text_en: Texas Instruments announced on February 4, 2026 a definitive agreement to acquire Silicon Labs for $231.00 per share in cash, a total enterprise value of approximately $7.5 billion

source.label: Texas Instruments 10-K
source.quote: As announced on February 4, 2026, we have entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Silicon Labs for $231.00 per share in an all-cash transaction, representing a total enterprise value of approximately $7.5 billion.

relations.text: Texas InstrumentsによるSilicon Labsの買収後は、製造を外部ファウンドリからTI自社の生産能力へ移す計画
relations.text_en: Under Texas Instruments' planned acquisition, Silicon Labs' manufacturing would move from external foundries to TI's internally owned capacity.

source.label: Texas Instruments · Agreement to acquire Silicon Labs, expected first half 2027
source.label_en: Texas Instruments · Agreement to acquire Silicon Labs, expected first half 2027
source.quote: The transaction positions the combined company to deliver fully integrated process, design and manufacturing capabilities by reshoring Silicon Labs' manufacturing from external foundries, leveraging Texas Instruments' industry-leading and internally owned capacity.
source.note: 買収は計画段階です(2027年前半の完了見込み)。
source.note_en: The acquisition is pending (expected in the first half of 2027).

companies.name: スカイワークス・ソリューションズ

relations.text: Skyworksは、Silicon LabsのInfrastructure and Automotive事業の買収代金の一部に充てるため、2021年7月26日に10億ドルのターム・ローンを借り入れた
relations.text_en: Skyworks borrowed $1.0 billion in term loans on July 26, 2021 to finance a portion of the purchase price for the acquisition of Silicon Labs' Infrastructure and Automotive business

source.label: Skyworks Solutions 10-K
source.quote: On July 26, 2021, the Company borrowed $ 1.0 billion in aggregate principal amount of term loans (the “Term Loans”) under the Term Loan Facility to finance a portion of the purchase price for the acquisition of the Infrastructure and Automotive business of Silicon Laboratories Inc. and to pay fees and expenses incurred in connection therewith.

companies.name: アマゾン・ドット・コム

relations.text: スマートホーム向けソリューションは、MatterやAmazon Sidewalkなどの新しい用途に対応している
relations.text_en: Silicon Labs' smart home solutions include support for emerging applications like Matter and Amazon Sidewalk

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: Our secure, reliable, and robust smart home solutions also include support for emerging applications like Matter and Amazon Sidewalk that are designed to streamline customer adoption while providing functionality that reinforces privacy, simplicity, and performance. – Home cameras
source.note: 対応規格としての記載です。

companies.name: グローバルファウンドリーズ

relations.text: GlobalFoundriesはシリコン・ラボラトリーズのパートナーだ
relations.text_en: GlobalFoundries is a partner of Silicon Labs

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: will depart to join partner GlobalFoundries as CFO;
source.note: プレスリリース上の記載のみです。
source.note_en: Mentioned only in a press release.

companies.name: バンク・オブ・アメリカ

relations.text: Bank of America, N.A.などを貸し手とするクレジット契約(2012年7月31日付)をSilicon Laboratoriesが締結している
relations.text_en: Silicon Laboratories has a credit agreement dated July 31, 2012 with Bank of America, N.A. and others

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: 10.2* Credit Agreement, dated July 31, 2012, by and among Silicon Laboratories Inc., the subsidiaries of the borrower identified therein, Bank of America, N.A., Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, and Regions Bank (filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the Form 8-K filed August 1, 2012).
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係で、古い契約です。
source.note_en: Financing relationship only; an older agreement.

relations.text: 同契約の第1次修正(2015年7月24日付)がある
relations.text_en: A First Amendment to the credit agreement is dated July 24, 2015

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: 10.3* First Amendment to Credit Agreement, dated July 24, 2015, by and among Silicon Laboratories Inc., the subsidiaries of the borrower identified therein, Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, Citibank, N.A., Regions Bank, Bank of America, N.A. and the lenders party thereto (filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the Form 8-K filed on July 29, 2015).

companies.name: マイクロチップ・テクノロジー
companies.sub: マイコン・アナログ半導体

relations.text: シリコン・ラボラトリーズと競合する

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: We compete with Espressif, Infineon, MediaTek, Microchip, Nordic Semiconductor, NXP, Qualcomm, Renesas, STMicroelectronics, Synaptics, Telink, Texas Instruments and others.

relations.text: Silicon Labsは、エッジAI(NPU)プロセッサ市場でCEVAと競う社内開発チームを抱える
relations.text_en: Silicon Labs has internal engineering teams that compete with CEVA in the edge AI (NPU) processor market.

source.label: CEVA 10-K
source.quote: We compete in the edge AI (NPU) processor market with AI processor and accelerator providers, including Arm, Cadence, Cambricon, Digital Media Professionals (DMP), Quadric, Imagination Technologies, Nvidia open source NVDLA and Verisilicon, and with internal engineering teams at companies such as Infineon, Silicon Labs and NXP.

relations.text: Silicon Labsの社内開発チームは、短距離無線市場でもCEVAと競合する
relations.text_en: Silicon Labs' internal engineering teams also compete with CEVA in the short-range wireless markets.

source.label: CEVA 10-K
source.quote: We compete in the short-range wireless markets with established and emerging wireless IP providers and internal engineering teams at companies such as Infineon, Silicon Labs and NXP.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
